text: No occupancy figure was reported for Sunday 15 Nov: no Reception or Operations report was seen. The last reported figure is 93 of 183 rooms occupied on 13 Nov (50.8%).

15 Nov was the Sunday off day; HR reported that only the two café baristas and the Operations Manager were on duty, 9 am to 8 pm. Reports for 15 Nov received from HR & Accounts and the Flower shop. Operations summary and AJ1881 sales not seen. HR & Accounts also sent its missing 14 Nov reports on the morning of 16 Nov.

Accounts reported no money received and no cheques deposited or returned on 15 Nov, and no overdue rent. A room payment for room 412 was recorded on 14 Nov. The Etisalat bill (internet, mobile and telephone) is still awaiting approval. The payments section will be resent once the café invoices are in.
A new café barista joined on 15 Nov. HR’s 14 and 15 Nov reports list offer letters still required and visa processing pending for 4 staff; no leave or absences reported.

Flower shop sales AED 0 on 15 Nov. It completed the weekly vase arrangements for IHC and Sirius Holdings, 18 mini bouquets for the Pilates studio opening giveaway and one large custom bouquet; no problems reported. Next priority: UAE National Day arrangements. AJ1881 sales for 15 Nov not reported.

Awaiting decision: room 710 FCU rewinding, the new Etisalat Wi-Fi line, the Etisalat bill payment, the MBG accounting and VAT proposal, the AJ1881 coffee machine, and pending offer letters and visa processing. The CEO’s 48-hour instruction of 12 Nov (cleaning, pest control, pool, drainage, preventive maintenance) and the outcome of the Sunday opening event are not yet confirmed.
